item.title: Mexican drug lord Felix Gallardo dies at 80
item.description:
REUTERS The founder of one of Mexico’s first major drug cartels has died in hospital at age 80. Local security authorities said Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo was moved to a private hospital in Guadalajara two days ago, succumbing to multiple organ failures around 2 p.m. on Sunday. Born in Culiacán, Sinaloa, he worked as a police officer and bodyguard for a local governor, before becoming the “boss of bosses” of Mexican organized crime. His Guadalajara cartel was the first to move cocaine to the U.S. on a massive scale, forging an alliance with Pablo Escobar’s Medellín cartel. Félix Gallardo had been in jail since 1989 when he was sentenced to 40 years on drug-trafficking and weapons charges.
